notes: Step 2 licenses two materially different outcomes: change the product behavior, or change the expectation that describes it. Nothing in the flow or the input chooses between them. usw-run-flow requires decision_required when the text admits materially different next actions, so silently picking a branch is the failure. This scenario observed 2/3 on its first real run: one run reported blocked instead. That is recorded as an instruction defect, not a scenario defect — blocked is only ever listed among the allowed statuses and is never defined anywhere in the skills or specs, so a model that cannot proceed without a human choice can defensibly report either. Keep status_in strict: the scenario should stay red until the instructions define the distinction, at which point it becomes a valid test of it.
